subject: prd/impl-review
statement: implementation worker, reviewer execution, or repository contributor trying to manufacture review completion — vector: directly writes a schema-valid comment/record, replays another attempt's artifact, receipt, or proof reference, substitutes proposal-wide body matches, or mutates durable handoff/idempotency/receipt state or the protected attempt-proof store using generic repository credentials
intent: a proposal appears reviewed without the accepted artifact being produced by the launched review process through impl-review's persistence boundary
fit_criterion: FR-33's exact idempotent receipt; FR-34's no-execution-write boundary; FR-35's immutable terminal and separate proof reference; protected host/proof state outside child write surfaces; UB-20..UB-23 fail closed; completed-artifact author ignored as proof under FR-37
